meta.name: dream-video-prompt-generator
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者在制作数字人带货短视频时，用本技能一键生成即梦视频中英文提示词。依托四大智能体协同与专属公式，确保人物与情绪高度一致，完美适配5s带货场景，高效产出高质量分镜脚本，让视频制作事半功倍！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入带货主题，生成数字人短视频的中英文分镜提示词
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是电商运营或内容创作者，常做数字人带货短视频却苦于写提示词。
copy.tagline_en: Turn product info into bilingual video prompts for digital-human selling clips.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you create digital-human selling videos and struggle with prompt writing.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会为小省导购员数字人带货视频生成即梦提示词，按「主体+运动+场景+镜头/光影/氛围」公式输出中英文对照的分镜提示词，并附 Suno 音乐提示词和 AI 绘画提示词。
howto.when: 当你需要生成小省导购员数字人带货视频的提示词时触发；需提供场景类型、情绪基调，分镜与时长默认 5 幕、每幕 5s。

say.text: 帮我生成5幕产品推荐视频的即梦提示词，情绪热情专业
say.note: 会核查知识库，输出中英文提示词

say.text: 生成5幕促销活动的即梦提示词，基调紧迫热情
say.note: 同时给出 Suno 音乐和 AI 绘画提示词

say.text: 把这次的价格对比提示词归档到知识库
say.note: 归档角色描述与五幕模板

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude generates Jimeng video prompts for the Xiaosheng shopping-guide digital human, outputting bilingual five-scene prompts by formula plus Suno music and AI painting prompts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need prompts for a Xiaosheng shopping-guide digital human video; you give the scene type and emotion tone, defaulting to 5 scenes of 5s each.

say_en.text: Generate Jimeng prompts for a 5-scene product video, professional tone.
say_en.note: Checks the knowledge base, returns Chinese and English prompts.

say_en.text: Create 5-scene promo event prompts with an urgent tone.
say_en.note: Also outputs Suno music and AI painting prompts.

say_en.text: Archive this price comparison prompt set to the knowledge base.
say_en.note: Saves the character profile and five-scene templates.
